about.title: About Hyperion
about.description: A mod manager for Cyberpunk 2077. Mods stay out of your game folder, conflicts are easy to see, and you control the load order.
about.projectBody: Install, check, and reorder your mods, then launch the game. When you close it, your game folder is clean again.
about.supportBody: When reporting a bug, include your Hyperion version and the diagnostics summary. They make launch and path problems much easier to track down.
about.creditsDescription: The tools and projects Hyperion is built on.

credits.coreVfsBody: Mods are mounted over the game by usvfs, the virtual file system from Mod Organizer 2.
credits.resourceDataBody: Archive-resource conflicts are named using the community resource-hash database from the WolvenKit project.
credits.extractionBody: Mod archives (.zip, .rar, .7z) are unpacked with 7-Zip by Igor Pavlov.
credits.serviceApiBody: Account checks, update checks, nxm links, and Premium downloads.
credits.referenceBody: Documentation on archives, load order, and Cyberpunk modding.

about.disclaimer: Hyperion is not affiliated with CD PROJEKT RED, Nexus Mods, Mod Organizer 2, the usvfs maintainers, the WolvenKit project, or 7-Zip.

overwrite.title: Overwrite Preview
overwrite.descriptionLosing: This install shares game-target paths with enabled mods. Hyperion will respect library order, so files from mods below this position still win over the incoming mod.
overwrite.descriptionWinning: This install shares game-target paths with enabled mods. Hyperion will deploy it using library order, so the incoming mod will take priority where it lands later in the stack.
overwrite.descriptionArchive: This install also touches archive resources already present in enabled mods. Review the overlap before continuing.

overwrite.priorityNote: Mods with a higher `#` position than this install will keep priority on those shared paths.
